issue.title: Feature request #3649 fix

repository.name: CodeIgniter
repository.description: Open Source PHP Framework (originally from EllisLab)

issue.body:
I have prepared a solution for the feature requested in https://github.com/bcit-ci/CodeIgniter/issues/3649.
It includes two new configuration variables for the Sessions, allowing CodeIgniter ci_session value to be coherent with whatever values we have set in our PHP.ini configuration:
- session.hash_function
- session.hash_bits_per_character

Also this change is backward compatible as default values in config.php are the same as the hard coded values in the existing Session.php.

It does not interfere with ini_set values set in index.php around line 285.

For testing it I created a test controller: https://github.com/bcit-ci/CodeIgniter/commit/02fe02d584f98761ff5a0665a13f5bd799c5cfdb

Please consider if is meaningful for the project.

Thank you,

Paco Bernabe

issue.title: [BUG] Sessions and PHP7/7.1

repository.name: CodeIgniter
repository.description: Open Source PHP Framework (originally from EllisLab)

issue.body:
Hello when i switch from php 5.6 to 7 or 7.1 my sessions stop working correctly.
What is happening? On every reload ci_session cookie is changing and php session too.
I tried files session storage,database, memcached no difference.
I also tried fresh codeigniter without modifications and problem still persists.

My webserver setup is managed with serverpilot.io and php-fpm services with provides me fast php swithing.

I use latest 3.1.0 ci.
